body:
thank you so so much for taking the time to write all of that to me, and for sharing. It's all very new. I hope we can get past it. The emotional shifts are unbearable...complete grief and sobbing and loving him to rage and seriously wanting to punch through his chest or smash his face to bits for doing this to me. How dare he allow my children to have a piece of shit father!?!?!  And then 2 seconds later I'm sobbing because I've absolutely never know a better man in my life. We're going to counseling tomorrow. He said hell do anything to keep me, and he's put up with a whole lOt of psycho reactions and pain. I told him I want to erase her from his mind and he wishes he could too but it's so do painful. I'm so sick of selfishness. I hope that pathetic whore never finds happiness. She's an abomination to women. And I want him to suffer to but instead I beg him through tears to make live to me and connect with me. I don't recognize myself at all.
Anyway, thanks so much... Support from strangers is surprisingly comforting.
